resolution: Retain the original two transport commits in main history, but do not activate their source-replacing, self-pushing workflow or overwrite the current ordinary objective compiler, Cargo state, module registry, technical guide, status or work-package decisions. The incoming head changes no ordinary product source file. Its proposed encoded patch is retained as historical proposal material, not asserted to be the implementation selected by main.
payloadCaveat: The complete encoded payload was not programmatically materialized and its declared decoded digest was not independently recomputed here. No decoded equivalence, import or successful qualification is claimed. No unverified encoded patch is executed. Future reuse requires decoding from the preserved original commit, checking its declared digest and full path envelope, and reviewing it against a new exact main baseline.
